Reference1 is the approved new infantry/weapon family; reference2 is the exact game low-poly hand-painted style; reference3 supplies existing jeep colours/materials only. SUBJECT: ONE separate jeep minigun PEDESTAL ONLY. Square navy base plate about0.30m wide with four chunky integral bolt heads, a simple sturdy navy upright column approximately1.05m tall and0.16m thick, widening at the bottom. A simple compact open U-shaped fork bearing at top with two thick cheeks, clear open slot and coaxial pin holes to receive a separate gun trunnion. All these pieces are one connected pedestal. Low-poly painterly navy/steel-blue with one small coral doublechevron on the column, broad brush marks and modest painted wear matching the jeep. No minigun, weapon barrels, operator, vehicle, seat, ground, tripod, platform beyond the small baseplate or spare detached parts.
Economical exaggerated low-poly3D masses with BROAD VISIBLE GOUACHE albedo brush strokes, navy shadows and steel-blue painted highlights, warm peach skin where applicable, coral accents, no shiny plastic or photoreal PBR.
Squarecomposition, one single three-quarter view, centred with all parts visible and generous pure white (#FFFFFF) margins. No labels,text,logos, scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, muzzle flashes, smoke, tracers, floating embellishments or alternate views.
review: Baseplate too broad relative to height to fit the measured jeep rear bed at the required barrel-clearance height. Narrow base/longer stem reference required.
